description: Cases for tools/lib/dist-tokens.mjs and tools/lib/dist-data-urls.mjs (run with `node tools/check-dist.mjs --self-test`). `cases`: token scanner — `expect` maps each token that must be reported to its kind: forbidden | warn | vite-modulepreload; tokens absent from `expect` must not be reported. `dataUrlCases`: inlined data: URLs vs CSP — `expect` lists every data: URL as { mime, directive, blocked } (order-insensitive); an empty list means nothing may be reported.

cases.name: Vite modulepreload polyfill, minified entry chunk (Vite 7.3.x, copied from a production bundle)
cases.text: (function(){const o=document.createElement("link").relList;if(o&&o.supports&&o.supports("modulepreload"))return;for(const d of document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="modulepreload"]'))r(d);new MutationObserver(d=>{for(const h of d)if(h.type==="childList")for(const v of h.addedNodes)v.tagName==="LINK"&&v.rel==="modulepreload"&&r(v)}).observe(document,{childList:!0,subtree:!0});function s(d){const h={};return d.integrity&&(h.integrity=d.integrity),d.referrerPolicy&&(h.referrerPolicy=d.referrerPolicy),d.crossOrigin==="use-credentials"?h.credentials="include":d.crossOrigin==="anonymous"?h.credentials="omit":h.credentials="same-origin",h}function r(d){if(d.ep)return;d.ep=!0;const h=s(d);fetch(d.href,h)}})();function Vg(o){return o&&o.__esModule&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(o,"default")?o.default:o}

cases.name: Vite modulepreload polyfill, unminified shape (identifiers as in Vite's source)
cases.text: (function polyfill() { const relList = document.createElement("link").relList; if (relList && relList.supports && relList.supports("modulepreload")) { return; } for (const link of document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="modulepreload"]')) { processPreload(link); } function getFetchOpts(link) { const fetchOpts = {}; fetchOpts.credentials = "same-origin"; return fetchOpts; } function processPreload(link) { if (link.ep) return; link.ep = true; const fetchOpts = getFetchOpts(link); fetch(link.href, fetchOpts); } })();

cases.name: application fetch to an API path is forbidden
cases.text: async function load(){const r=await fetch("/api/items",{method:"GET"});return r.json()}

cases.name: fetch(x.href, opts) outside the polyfill (no preload marker, no relList) is forbidden
fetch(x.href, opts) with the words modulepreload and relList nearby but no .ep marker is forbidden
polyfill followed by an application fetch reports the application call as forbidden
prefetch( and refetch( are not fetch(
storage APIs via property access are forbidden
identifiers that merely contain a token are not reported
XMLHttpRequest and WebSocket constructors are forbidden

dataUrlCases.name: CSS: inlined woff2 font subset under the canonical CSP (font-src 'self', no data:) is blocked
dataUrlCases.csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'

dataUrlCases.name: CSS: one woff and one woff2 inlined in the same file are both blocked under font-src 'self'
CSS: inlined SVG image is permitted because img-src lists data:
CSS: inlined font is permitted when font-src lists data:
CSS: file and external url() references are not data: URLs (nothing reported by this rule)
CSS: an unknown mime falls back to default-src, which has no data: → blocked
CSS: no font-src directive → default-src governs, and it lists data: → permitted
JS: an inlined font string literal under the canonical CSP is blocked
JS: an inlined PNG string literal is permitted because img-src lists data:
JS: bare "data:" and prose containing data: without a mime type are not data: URLs
